visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera focuses on a monitor displaying security footage where a man with long hair and a woman in a blue shirt are seen kissing in a corridor. The physical camera then pans rapidly across a brightly lit indoor room showing boxes, a plant, and a white tiled wall. (2) Returning to the monitor, the woman in the security footage walks into a bathroom while the man stands outside holding his phone. (3) A woman in a dark graphic t-shirt in the room reacts with shocked facial expressions and points toward the screen. (4) Two women are seen running quickly through a white hallway with multiple closed doors; one woman wears a green t-shirt with a 'SHINING' tropical print. (5) They reach a white door and push it open to reveal a man in a tight yellow one-piece swimsuit posing next to a woman wearing a birthday hat who holds a printed sign. Confetti and party poppers are triggered.
